items.name: Freedom of lawful expression and independent judgment
items.description: First Amendment; no government-determined acceptable ideology.

items.name: Individual due process and effective redress
items.description: Process before deprivation and meaningful challenge of legal decisions are context-dependent.

items.name: Distinct State and federal authority
items.description: Respect reserved State and people's powers and the legal limits of federal funding conditions.

items.name: Personal data purpose, privacy and minimization
items.description: Privacy is broader than cybersecurity; lawful purposes and specific governing law must be determined separately.

items.name: Congressional appropriations and fiscal accountability
items.description: Fiscal or budget concepts cannot grant executive spending or taxing authority.

items.name: Just compensation and lawful treatment of property
items.description: Public acquisition scenarios must not bypass public-use and just-compensation requirements where applicable.

items.name: Meaningful access and nondiscriminatory service outcomes
items.description: Existing equality obligations are context-dependent; no proposed universal service promise is treated as enacted.

items.name: Judicial independence and bounded adjudication
items.description: Courts decide cases under actual jurisdiction; planning cannot turn them into executive program managers.

items.name: Transparent evidence, public dissent and revision
items.description: People must be able to contest evidence, proposed values and use of statistics without compelled agreement.

items.name: Civilian, military and intelligence boundary
items.description: Domestic cyber assistance or emergency powers cannot be inferred from technical capability; specific statutes and constitutional limits require research.
